newsitem.title: USA: Royal Appliance says report may mislead.
newsitem.headline: Royal Appliance says report may mislead.

text.p: Royal Appliance Manufacturing Co said Friday that a published report quoting its president might give a misleading notion of sales of the company's Dirt Devil vacuum.

The newspaper USA Today, reporting on response to ads featuring Fred Astaire dancing with a Dirt Devil, said, "Mike Merriman, president of the Royal Appliance Manufacturing Co in Cleveland, said Thursday that due to that ad, sales of the Dirt Devil upright are up 76 percent over the same time last year."

Royal Appliance said today, "The sales increase is based upon retail point-of-sale information for the four-week period immediately after the Super Bowl, as provided to the company from certain of its top customers for the upright product line only."

It continued, "The information does not reflect shipments or sales by the company of its uprights or its other product lines. Moreover, upright retail point-of-sale increases for the last week of the four-week ad campaign were up 28 percent for the same customers.
"No prediction should be inferred from these retail point-of-sale reports with respect to the company's total net sales, either for the current quarter or the year."
